items.title: Scientists warn Atlantic currents may slow faster than expected

sentences.en: Scientists warn Atlantic currents may slow faster than expected.
sentences.zh: 科学家警告，大西洋洋流可能比预期更快减缓。

sentences.en: A new assessment of the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation suggests the system that helps keep Europe's winters mild is losing stability.
sentences.zh: 对大西洋经向翻转环流的最新评估显示，这套帮助欧洲冬季保持温和的系统正在失去稳定。

sentences.en: Researchers say the finding is not a prediction of collapse this decade, but it raises the cost of delay on emissions cuts.
sentences.zh: 研究人员表示，这并非预言本十年就会崩溃，但会提高推迟减排的代价。

items.title: Voters in several countries head to the polls as coalition talks stall

sentences.en: Voters in several countries head to the polls as coalition talks stall.
sentences.zh: 多个国家的选民走向投票站，与此同时组阁谈判陷入停滞。

sentences.en: Turnout was higher than expected in urban districts, while rural counties reported delays at polling stations.
sentences.zh: 城市选区的投票率高于预期，农村地区则报告投票站出现延误。

sentences.en: Analysts say the result may hinge on undecided voters who list the cost of living as their top concern.
sentences.zh: 分析人士认为，结果可能取决于把生活成本列为首要关切的中间选民。

items.title: Supply chains ease, but shipping costs remain a drag on small exporters

sentences.en: Supply chains ease, but shipping costs remain a drag on small exporters.
sentences.zh: 供应链有所缓解，但运费仍拖累小型出口商。

sentences.en: Port congestion has fallen from last year's peak, according to industry trackers.
sentences.zh: 行业追踪数据显示，港口拥堵已从去年峰值回落。

sentences.en: Even so, smaller firms say they still struggle to lock in predictable freight rates for the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，较小的公司表示，它们仍难以为假日季锁定可预期的运费。

items.title: UN agencies appeal for sustained funding as drought spreads

sentences.en: UN agencies appeal for sustained funding as drought spreads.
sentences.zh: 随着旱情蔓延，联合国机构呼吁提供持续资金。

sentences.en: Humanitarian coordinators warned that short-term pledges cannot replace multi-year support for water, food, and health services.
sentences.zh: 人道主义协调员警告，短期认捐无法替代对水、粮食和卫生服务的多年支持。

sentences.en: Local clinics report rising malnutrition among children under five.
sentences.zh: 当地诊所报告五岁以下儿童营养不良情况上升。

items.title: Governments debate cross-border rules for digital identity wallets

sentences.en: Governments debate cross-border rules for digital identity wallets.
sentences.zh: 各国政府正在讨论数字身份钱包的跨境规则。

sentences.en: Privacy advocates argue that interoperability must not become a back door for bulk surveillance.
sentences.zh: 隐私倡导者认为，互操作性绝不能成为大规模监控的后门。

sentences.en: Officials counter that shared standards would cut fraud in travel and banking.
sentences.zh: 官员则反驳说，共享标准将减少旅行和银行业务中的欺诈。

items.title: GitHub outlines safer defaults for Actions in public repositories

sentences.en: GitHub outlines safer defaults for Actions in public repositories.
sentences.zh: GitHub 概述了公共仓库中 Actions 的更安全默认设置。

sentences.en: The company says new repositories will require explicit approval before workflows from first-time contributors can run.
sentences.zh: 该公司表示，新仓库将要求在首次贡献者的工作流运行前获得明确批准。

sentences.en: Maintainers can still opt into more permissive settings if they accept the extra review burden.
sentences.zh: 如果维护者愿意承担额外的审查负担，仍可选择更宽松的设置。

items.title: AWS expands Graviton-based instances for memory-heavy workloads

sentences.en: AWS expands Graviton-based instances for memory-heavy workloads.
sentences.zh: AWS 扩展了面向高内存负载的 Graviton 实例。

sentences.en: The new sizes target in-memory databases and real-time analytics, with higher network throughput per vCPU.
sentences.zh: 新规格面向内存数据库和实时分析，每个 vCPU 的网络吞吐更高。

sentences.en: Customers can migrate existing Arm images without changing their deployment pipelines.
sentences.zh: 客户可以迁移现有的 Arm 镜像，而无需改动部署流水线。

items.title: Google open-sources a smaller on-device model for offline translation

sentences.en: Google open-sources a smaller on-device model for offline translation.
sentences.zh: Google 开源了一款更小的端侧离线翻译模型。

sentences.en: The release includes quantized weights and a reference Android sample that runs without a network connection.
sentences.zh: 此次发布包含量化权重，以及一个无需网络即可运行的 Android 参考示例。

sentences.en: Researchers note that on-device inference trades some fluency for privacy and latency.
sentences.zh: 研究人员指出，端侧推理会用部分流畅度换取隐私和更低延迟。

items.title: TypeScript previews faster project references for monorepos

sentences.en: TypeScript previews faster project references for monorepos.
sentences.zh: TypeScript 预览了面向单体仓库的更快项目引用。

sentences.en: The compiler can now reuse incremental graphs across packages, cutting cold-start times in large workspaces.
sentences.zh: 编译器现在可以在包之间复用增量图，从而缩短大型工作区的冷启动时间。

sentences.en: The team is asking for feedback from repositories that already split types into dedicated packages.
sentences.zh: 团队正在向已经把类型拆到独立包里的仓库征求反馈。

items.title: Cloudflare details a new bot fight mode for API gateways

sentences.en: Cloudflare details a new bot fight mode for API gateways.
sentences.zh: Cloudflare 介绍了面向 API 网关的新反机器人模式。

sentences.en: Instead of blocking only browsers, the feature scores machine-to-machine traffic using request rhythm and token reuse.
sentences.zh: 该功能不只拦截浏览器，还会根据请求节奏和令牌复用对机器对机器流量打分。

sentences.en: False positives can be tuned with allowlists for known CI systems and partner integrations.
sentences.zh: 可通过为已知 CI 系统和合作伙伴集成设置白名单，来调节误报。

items.title: Gateway API graduates another feature for traffic splitting

sentences.en: Gateway API graduates another feature for traffic splitting.
sentences.zh: Gateway API 又有一项流量分割功能毕业。

sentences.en: Cluster operators can now declare canary weights in a portable way across conforming implementations.
sentences.zh: 集群运维现在可以用可移植的方式，在符合规范的实现之间声明金丝雀权重。

sentences.en: The Kubernetes SIG Network says the change reduces the need for vendor-specific annotations.
sentences.zh: Kubernetes SIG Network 表示，这一变化减少了对厂商专有注解的依赖。
